data.name: Shraddha
data.long_meaning: The Sanskrit word ‘Shraddha’ is derived from the root word ‘Shradh’ which means ‘to give’. It denotes the feeling of deep reverence and faith towards a deity or a person. In Hinduism, it is considered as the foundation of all virtues and the key to attaining spiritual growth.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Shraddha is a 7 Destiny number, which indicates a creative, expressive, and artistic personality. It is also a number of spiritual growth and transformation.

vedic_reference.note: Shraddha is a virtue mentioned in various Hindu scriptures, including the Vedas and the Bhagavad Gita.

data.cultural_impact: The name ‘Shraddha’ symbolizes the deepest form of respect and devotion towards a deity, an ancestor, or a loved one. In Hindu rituals, Shraddha involves performing Pooja (worship) and Tarpan (offering food to departed souls) in remembrance of the ancestors, with a sincere and heartfelt intention. It is an integral part of various Hindu religious and cultural practices and serves as a reminded of the importance of preserving familial and spiritual bonds.
data.spiritual_significance: The name ‘Shraddha’ holds immense significance in the spiritual realm. It is the seed of faith that grows into the immense banyan tree of devotion. It represents the pure consciousness that acknowledges the unity and existence of the divine in all beings. The cultivation of Shraddha brings about inner peace, aasaan-the heart is at peace and content, and a greater sense of connection with the divine and the universe. In essence, Shraddha is a transformational force that enlightens the soul and uplifts the spirit.

historical_references.reference: Shraddha was a prominent wife of King Shibi of Haihayas dynasty. She is remembered for her selfless devotion towards her husband, who was a renowned king known for his kindness towards birds. Shraddha was the reincarnation of a bird who had been killed by Shibi in his previous life. She is believed to have taken birth in a royal family to be with Shibi in this life.

Shraddha is also a term in Hinduism that refers to faith and belief in the existence and power of a God or a deity. It also signifies the trust and confidence that an individual has towards his/her belief system and the divine.

modern_usage.modern_context: In today's interconnected world, the name Shraddha continues to be cherished by Hindu families globally. It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Devi Shraddha in Kolkata, India attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Shraddha, which means "Faith, Trust". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Shraddha signifies unwavering faith and devotion towards the divine. It embodies the trust and belief in the sanctity of spiritual practices and the inner guide, leading to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
